summary: Frontend-only auth integration test for /career-path-2028.html. Verified Firebase Auth signup, reaching landing, entering JEE app, userChip display, logout returning to auth screen, and re-login with the same credentials. All auth flows PASS. Firestore permission-denied toast appears as expected (external config step, not a code bug).
critical_code_review_comments: doLogout() awaits pushCloud() before signOut(); pushCloud silently swallows errors but this could delay logout when Firestore is slow. Currently harmless.
The 'Firestore rules block access' toast is correctly surfaced when permission-denied is detected — good UX fix.
userChip is only visible after entering an exam (not on landing); users cannot log out directly from the landing page. Consider adding a compact logout affordance on #landing.
test_credentials: Fresh accounts created each run: qa<timestamp>@example.com / Test12345 (e.g. qa1787160385@example.com). Persisted in Firebase Auth project career-path-2028.
seed_data_creation: Signup created 3 test Firebase Auth accounts during runs (qa1787160296, qa1787160353, qa1787160385 @example.com). No Firestore docs created (blocked by rules as expected).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Auth flow (signup, JEE enter, logout, re-login) fully verified against embedded Firebase config. Firestore rules are unpublished by design; permission-denied toast is expected. userChip logout is only accessible from in-app (top bar), not from landing — enter an exam first before attempting logout.
rca of the issue: N/A - original reported bug ('Cloud sync issue') is resolved: Firebase config now embedded, and the toast now correctly identifies Firestore rule blockage. Publishing Firestore rules is a manual user step.
